[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经获悉我们对[pre_ftl_country.GetAdj]母星的入侵。他们正式告知我们这一行为违反了不予干涉法案。

[Root.GetName]在接下来的十年内将会被视为违反星系法。此外，我们还应缴纳巨额罚金。
texts.en:
Our invasion of the [pre_ftl_country.GetAdj] homeworld has been noted by the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]. They have informed us that this is a clear violation of the Non-Interference Act.

The [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law for the next ten years. In addition, we have been issued with a hefty fine.
